status: DRAFT FOR REVIEW — not approved, not hashed, not executable. On approval: remove '-DRAFT', resolve open_questions, record SHA-256 in docs/protocol_v4.sha256, then implement the listed code changes BEFORE any v4 data is built.
supersedes: protocol v3 (docs/protocol_v3.json, SHA-256 e97171dadedf57083265fc6bb38306942da5df41df32d079439bc11331d79e7e). v3 was never executed: no pool, test set or model was built under it. v3 and its hash file stay unchanged as a record.
changes_from_v3: C1 IMC25 'hey mum/dad' (family-impersonation fraud) mapped to suspicious instead of excluded.
C2 Mendeley 'Financial scams detection dataset' added as a SUPPLEMENTARY, TRAIN-ONLY source; its ham is general non-scam text and never counts as verified genuine financial alerts.
C3 Shared anonymiser upgraded to anon-v2 (adds social-media handles and residual e-mail fragments) for every source, train and test, and at inference.

C4 Template clustering uses an exact Jaccard >= 0.6 similarity join (prefix filtering) instead of rarest-3-token blocking, so near-duplicates are grouped before assignment rather than discovered afterwards by the leakage check.
C5 New assignment salt and v4 file names (pool, frozen test, manifest, evaluation log).
C6 Reporting additions: per-source counts for Mendeley, S1 recall reported separately for the 'hey mum/dad' subset (not a new criterion).

scope.role: Advisory only. A classifier output must never by itself produce a definitive high-risk / fraud decision. Person 2's decision engine is not modified.
scope.retired_benchmark: data/real_world_test_v1.csv stays retired from all selection and tuning; used only to remove overlapping rows; may be evaluated once for the final selected model after the sealed evaluation, reported separately.
scope.out_of_scope: Website-screenshot phishing detection (Phish360) and payment-receipt verification (payment_ocr.py) are separate workstreams and are not governed by this protocol.

sources.DONATION: unchanged from v3 (CONSENT-v1, scripts/donate_messages.py, validated by scripts/donation_progress.py; roles train + test). Donations are masked with anon-v1 at finalise time; the build re-applies anon-v2 (anon-v2 = anon-v1 + extra rules, so re-application is consistent).
sources.R115: unchanged from v3 (gpt-oss-120b rows only; train only)

anonymisation.definition: anon-v1 unchanged, then: @handles (letter/underscore start, <= 30 chars) -> handletoken; residual e-mail fragments with a letter on both sides of '@' and dangling local parts -> emailtoken. Rates/prices ('@ 9.9%', 'Rs@499') and standalone '@' are kept.
anonymisation.regression_tests: tests/test_anonymiser_versions.py (anon-v1 golden outputs frozen; anon-v2 behaviour)
anonymisation.applied_to: Every row of every source, both classes, train and test; models trained under v4 record preprocessing='anon-v2' and classify_text() applies it before vectorising.
anonymisation.measured_effect_2026_10_24: IMC25 (English, mapped): 97 rows change vs anon-v1 (53 handletoken, 45 new emailtoken); Mendeley 0; SYN 0. Residual '@' in IMC25 after anon-v2: 139 standalone, 19 '@'+digits (prices/rates), 11 other.

build_order: 1. Verify protocol hash; download/verify pinned sources (SHA-256); never modify raw files.
2. Map labels; exclude ambiguous labels, non-English IMC25 rows and non-Latin Mendeley rows; log every exclusion with reason (no text).
3. Investigate >= 10-digit runs (IMC25, Mendeley), then anonymise all rows with anon-v2; stop if any >= 4-digit run remains.
4. Remove rows overlapping the retired benchmark or the challenge suite (exact normalised, skeleton, Jaccard >= 0.8 after anonymising both sides).
5. Exact normalised de-duplication, priority DONATION > IMC25 > MWOZ_TEST > MWOZ_TRAIN > MENDELEY > R115 > SYN; conflicting labels -> all copies excluded.
8. Cross-split leakage check over ALL train rows (including MENDELEY) vs test; hits remove the TRAIN group(s); repeat until zero.
10. Write pool and test; seal. Reports are counts only.

grouping.template_clustering: Within each source, link rows whose skeleton_text(anon-v2 text) token sets have Jaccard >= 0.6, found by an EXACT similarity join (prefix filtering, as text_classifier.jaccard_matches). Groups = connected components of base-key and template links.
grouping.group_id: <source>:<smallest stable row key in the component> (Mendeley key: 'line<N>')
grouping.giant_component_reporting: Report the size of the largest groups per source and the share of test rows contributed by the largest test group [open question Q4].

test_assignment.salt_note: Replace with 'satyalens-protocol-v4-<approval date>' on approval, before any data is built.
test_assignment.rule: unchanged from v3: IMC25 and DONATION groups are TEST if int(sha256(salt + '|' + group_id)[:8], 16) / 2**32 < 0.20; MWOZ_TEST all TEST; MWOZ_TRAIN, MENDELEY, R115, SYN all TRAIN.

minimum_legitimate_coverage: unchanged from v3 (collection >= 750 donated messages from >= 10 donors; test >= 150 donated from >= 5 donors with >= 3 categories of >= 25; otherwise L1 NOT EVALUABLE). MENDELEY rows never count.
model_selection: unchanged from v3 (pool TRAIN rows only; StratifiedGroupKFold 5, seed 42; candidates A_v1_config, C_stopwords_unigram, E_stopwords_C3, G_char_wb_3_5, H_char_wb_3_5_C3; same rule and DONATION-only constraint; baselines majority, rule engine, deployed v1, candidate v2) except input text is anon-v2 and per-source OOF metrics include MENDELEY.
acceptance_criteria: unchanged from v3 (S1 >= 0.80, S2 >= 0.80, L1 <= 0.10 or NOT EVALUABLE, L2 <= 0.05, M1 >= 0.80, B1; inconclusive suspicious = miss). Additionally REPORTED (not gating): S1 restricted to 'hey mum/dad' test rows.

sealing.guard: unchanged mechanism; text_classifier must be pointed at the v4 manifest (code change listed below).

required_code_changes_before_execution: text_classifier: accept preprocessing='anon-v2' (map to anonymise_v2) in train/classify/evaluate.
text_classifier: sealed-manifest default path -> reports/frozen_test_v4_manifest.json (keep v3 manifest recognised if it ever exists).
builder v4 (new script, v3 builder kept unchanged): Mendeley loader, 'hey mum/dad' mapping, anon-v2, exact 0.6 join, v4 file names.
select/acceptance v4 scripts: same logic, v4 paths; acceptance reports the 'hey mum/dad' subset.
Tests for each change; v3 scripts and tests remain and must still pass.

open_questions.Q1: Include IMC25 'hey mum/dad' (proposed: yes — it is fraud aimed at money transfer and matches SatyaLens scope)?
open_questions.Q2: Mendeley: Latin-script rows only (proposed), or also the 101 Bengali-script rows (no Bengali in any test source)?
open_questions.Q3: Mendeley ham as 'legitimate' training rows (proposed) — acceptable given it is general non-scam text, Bangladesh-centred, partly handwritten/re-typed?
open_questions.Q4: Exact 0.6 clustering may create very large IMC25 groups (largest v3 dry-run cluster 1,641; inspection-time cluster 4,097). If one lands in test it dominates S1. Accept, or cap/split giant components by a documented rule?
open_questions.Q5: Keep all v3 thresholds and coverage targets unchanged (proposed: yes)?
